mapper.sql: s.strategy_id, s.account_id, s.instrument_id, i.instrument_ticker, i.instrument_name, i.currency, s.side, s.quantity, s.trigger_direction, s.trigger_price, s.armed, s.valid_from, s.valid_until, s.max_order_value, s.max_position_qty, s.max_executions, s.max_failures, s.executions, s.consecutive_failures, s.status, s.status_reason, s.last_order_id, s.version, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.executed_at, s.cancelled_at
mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(CAST(#{accountId} AS INTEGER), 2)) AS locked

INSERT INTO strategy ( account_id, instrument_id, side, quantity, trigger_direction, trigger_price, armed, valid_from, valid_until, max_order_value, max_position_qty, max_executions, max_failures) SELECT CAST(#{s.accountId} AS INTEGER), CAST(#{s.instrumentId} AS INTEGER), CAST(#{s.side} AS VARCHAR), CAST(#{s.quantity} AS BIGINT), CAST(#{s.direction} AS VARCHAR), CAST(#{s.triggerPrice} AS NUMERIC(19, 4)), CAST(#{s.armed} AS BOOLEAN), CAST(#{s.validFrom,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE} AS TIMESTAMPTZ), CAST(#{s.validUntil,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE} AS TIMESTAMPTZ), CAST(#{s.maxOrderValue} AS NUMERIC(19, 2)), CAST(#{s.maxPositionQty} AS BIGINT), CAST(#{s.maxExecutions} AS INTEGER), CAST(#{s.maxFailures} AS INTEGER) WHERE ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM strategy WHERE account_id = #{s.accountId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'EXECUTING', 'DISABLED') ) < #{limit} RETURNING strategy_id
SELECT FROM strategy s JOIN instrument i ON i.instrument_id = s.instrument_id WHERE s.strategy_id = #{strategyId}
SELECT FROM strategy s JOIN instrument i ON i.instrument_id = s.instrument_id WHERE s.strategy_id = #{strategyId} FOR SHARE OF s
SELECT FROM strategy s JOIN instrument i ON i.instrument_id = s.instrument_id WHERE s.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.strategy_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE strategy SET status = 'DISABLED', status_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1 WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'EXECUTING')

UPDATE strategy SET status = 'ACTIVE', armed = FALSE, consecutive_failures = 0, status_reason = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} AND status = 'DISABLED' AND (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
UPDATE strategy SET status = 'CANCELLED', status_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1 WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'EXECUTING', 'DISABLED')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM strategy s JOIN instrument i ON i.instrument_id = s.instrument_id WHERE s.status IN ('FAILED', 'EXPIRED') AND s.notified_status IS DISTINCT FROM s.status ORDER BY s.strategy_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE strategy SET notified_status = status WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} AND status IN ('FAILED', 'EXPIRED')

UPDATE strategy_run SET settled_status = #{settledStatus}, settled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} AND run_number = #{runNumber} AND outcome IN ('ORDERED', 'DUPLICATE') AND settled_status IS NULL
